versions.changelog:
Initial release: Enables querying Shopee store rankings via Clawec API.

- Supports fetching Shopee 热销榜 (bestseller) and 飙升榜 (fast-rising) rankings across multiple countries and categories.
- Allows filtering by site, category, ranking type, time period (day/week/month), store type (local/cross-border), and product type.
- Provides detailed output including store sales, GMV, item count, followers, ratings, and links.
- Guides user to obtain and use API Key securely without hardcoding.
- Maps Chinese station/category names to required codes for easy queries.
- Includes sample scripts and reporting templates for efficient competitor analysis.
